storage.profile_selection: explicit OPL_PROFILE_WORKSPACE, otherwise the existing Profile Workspace convention
storage.workspace_selection: opaque workspace registry binding id; never a caller-supplied workspace path
storage.body_policy: leave original Markdown in the selected source; source setup never registers or accepts body content

knowledge_health.truncated: true when more than 100 active entries require inspection
knowledge_health.issues: bounded refs-only entries with knowledge_id, review_due or unavailable status, and a machine reason; never paths or bodies

projection_fields.available_consumers: current package domain declarations and already-explicit grants; the UI cannot invent a consumer
projection_fields.available_actions: same owner action catalog used by App and CLI

mutation_policy.revision_identity: context binding and source registry byte digests
mutation_policy.consumer_selection: must be explicitly selected from fresh owner choices; write domains are a subset of read domains
mutation_policy.source_scope_selection: explicit scope identifiers, limited by existing source grants and workspace binding
mutation_policy.complex_grants: multiple current-workspace grants are read-only in the simple form; preserve project/domain/scope relationships
mutation_policy.shared_binding_scope: cannot broaden registry scopes while another source is bound; show existing safe scope choices
mutation_policy.write_enablement: cannot activate another workspace's latent write grants
mutation_policy.disconnect: remove only selected source from current workspace binding; retain registry, other workspace grants, required knowledge declarations and original bodies
mutation_policy.reconnect: configure the same retained source identity with explicit domains/scopes and a fresh revision
mutation_policy.write_protocol: existing registry writer lock, atomic private file writes, CAS, fresh owner projection
mutation_policy.invalid_explicit_selection: report configuration failure; never fall back to another personal profile

read_policy.bodies: check at most 100 registered body hashes per source; never return them
read_policy.source_health: source access and accepted-body integrity are independent of record lifecycle; an overdue record retains review debt without making a readable source unavailable
read_policy.revision: current only when all inspected active body hashes match accepted versions and inspection is complete; unavailable or unreviewed bodies remain stale
read_policy.freshness: fresh describes the current recall-eligible subset after body and date checks; overdue and inactive counts remain explicit; no current items or truncated checks remain unknown
read_policy.recall_boundary: overdue and inactive records remain excluded by existing recall; required knowledge and action-critical gates are unchanged; source checks never extend review dates
read_policy.configuration_error: safe reason code with no selected path or provider payload
